{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload the data to ensure we start fresh
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
# Count how many are removed
initial_rows = len(data)
filtered_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
filtered_rows = len(filtered_data)
removed_rows = initial_rows - filtered_rows

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping highest sample_seq
# Sort and drop duplicates
deduplicated = filtered_data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = deduplicated['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Output all required numbers
print(f"Total rows in original data: {initial_rows}")
print(f"Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {removed_rows}")
print(f"Rows after filtering out -999: {filtered_rows}")
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(deduplicated)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}")"}
